title: Summit Seat Benefit Rate on Advance Seats
content:
**Crestline Summit Loyalty Program benefit terms as applied to seats on Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The seat price of an advance seat is multiplied by the **member seat rate**, which follows the Summit membership the ticket credits. The rate acts on the seat price before it is rounded to the cent.

## The rate

| Summit membership the ticket credits | Member seat rate |
|---|---|
| Active, and its tier includes the kind of seat bought | 0 |
| Active, and its tier includes complimentary preferred seating but not the kind of seat bought | 0.7 |
| Any other passenger (no membership, a membership that is not active, or an active tier with neither inclusion) | 1 |

## Which seats a tier includes

A Summit tier includes a **preferred seat** when its terms give complimentary preferred seating, and an **extra-legroom seat** when its terms give complimentary extra-legroom seating. The tier terms and the membership's status are read from the Summit membership record and the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program tier terms.

## Combinations (hypothetical)

| Seat bought | Tier gives preferred seating | Tier gives extra-legroom seating | Membership active | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Preferred | Yes | No | Yes | 0 |
| Extra-legroom | Yes | Yes | Yes | 0 |
| Extra-legroom | Yes | No | Yes | 0.7 |
| Standard | Yes | No | Yes | 0.7 |
| Preferred | Yes | No | No | 1 |
| Extra-legroom | No | No | Yes | 1 |

*Worked figure (hypothetical).* A seat price of 45 dollars with a member seat rate of 0.7 becomes 31.50 dollars.
